title: Frontend Engineer (prose-style posting, no bullets)
text: We're hiring a Frontend Engineer to join a team of six building a scheduling product used by clinics. Day to day you'll ship features in React and TypeScript, pair with a designer on our component library, and keep our Lighthouse scores above 90. You should have at least three years of professional experience with React and be comfortable writing accessible, well-tested UI. Familiarity with Next.js and Playwright is a plus, as is experience in healthcare or another regulated industry. We offer a hybrid schedule (two days in our Seoul office), a learning budget, and 20 days of paid leave. Interviews take about two weeks end to end.
